hints.title: Nesting Depth Distribution
hints.text: To minimize the maximum depth of both subsequences, split the alternating parenthesis layers evenly between the two groups.

hints.title: Parity of Current Depth
hints.text: Assign parentheses at odd depths to group 0 and parentheses at even depths to group 1.

hints.title: Depth Updates
hints.text: For an opening parenthesis, assign depth modulo 2 before incrementing depth. For a closing parenthesis, decrement depth and assign new depth modulo 2.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Trying all 2^N partition combinations is exponential and unnecessary for balanced parentheses.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Tracking nesting depth parity in a single linear pass divides maximum depth in half optimally.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should recognize that distributing depths modulo 2 keeps the difference between both groups at most 1.
complexity.notes: Can also be solved using index parity.
